title: Chapter 15 Quiz: Deployment & Final Project
description: Test your knowledge of production builds, environment variables, deployment platforms, and final project requirements.

questions.question: What command creates an optimized production build in a Vite Vue project?
questions.explanation: `npm run build` runs the Vite build command, outputting the `dist` folder.

questions.question: The `dist` folder contains unminified source code for debugging.
questions.explanation: The `dist` folder contains minified and optimized files for production.

questions.question: In Vite, environment variables must be prefixed with __________ to be exposed to the client.
questions.explanation: Only variables with the `VITE_` prefix are included in the client bundle for security reasons.

questions.question: Netlify can automatically deploy your site from a GitHub repository when you push code.
questions.explanation: Netlify's continuous deployment feature rebuilds and deploys on every push to the connected branch.

questions.question: Which of the following is a requirement for the capstone project?
options: At least 3 routes using Vue Router
questions.explanation: The capstone project must include multiple routes, but does not require a backend, chat, or SSR.

questions.question: The command to preview a production build locally is __________.
questions.explanation: Vite provides a preview server for the built `dist` folder.

questions.question: You can set environment variables in a `.env.production` file that will only be used when building for production.
questions.explanation: Vite loads `.env.production` in production mode, and `.env.development` in development.

questions.question: What is the purpose of continuous deployment?
options: To automatically build and deploy the latest code
questions.explanation: Continuous deployment automatically deploys new code changes to the live environment.

questions.question: The folder containing the built static files after `npm run build` is called __________.
questions.explanation: Vite outputs production files to the `dist` folder by default.

questions.question: GitHub Actions can be used to automate deployment to GitHub Pages.
questions.explanation: You can create a workflow that builds the app and pushes the `dist` folder to the `gh-pages` branch.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a recommended hosting platform for static Vue apps?
questions.explanation: MySQL is a database, not a static hosting platform. Netlify, Vercel, and GitHub Pages are all suitable.

questions.question: The `import.meta.env.MODE` variable returns the current __________.
questions.explanation: `import.meta.env.MODE` indicates whether the app is running in `development`, `production`, or another mode.

questions.question: The capstone project must include at least one composable.
questions.explanation: One of the requirements is to create at least two composables.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the `--report` flag when building a Vite app?
options: To generate a bundle size report
questions.explanation: The `--report` flag (or using plugins) creates a visual report of bundle sizes.

questions.question: To make a custom environment variable available in the browser, its name must start with __________.
questions.explanation: Only `VITE_` prefixed variables are included in the client bundle.

questions.question: Vercel automatically detects Vite projects and sets the correct build settings.
questions.explanation: Vercel has built‑in support for Vite and will automatically configure the build command and output directory.

questions.question: Which of the following is a valid way to access an environment variable inside a Vue component?
questions.explanation: In Vite, environment variables are accessed via `import.meta.env`.

questions.question: The process of automatically building and deploying code when changes are pushed to a repository is called __________.
questions.explanation: Continuous deployment (CD) automatically deploys the latest code changes.

questions.question: You should commit your `.env` files to version control to share them with your team.
questions.explanation: `.env` files often contain secrets and should be added to `.gitignore`. Use `.env.example` as a template.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the `npm run preview` command?
options: To start a development server with HMR
To serve the built `dist` folder locally
questions.explanation: `npm run preview` starts a local server to test the production build before deploying.
